title: Anda curry
skill: Boiled eggs in a simple curry

notes.text: Use the large pot for the curry, so the eggs fit in one layer.

move.title: A curry with eggs in it
move.body: Anda curry is an Indian egg curry, cooked in homes and roadside cafés all over India. Today you'll hard-boil eggs, cook frozen onion with jarred ginger and garlic and spices into a tomato sauce, and warm the eggs in it. Rice comes from a pouch.

why.title: Cook the onion golden
why.body: Onion cooked until golden makes the curry sweet and deep. Pale onion makes it taste raw.

why.title: Spices in the oil
why.body: Spices stirred in hot oil for 30 seconds wake up and smell stronger. Any longer, and they burn.

why.title: Cut little slits
why.body: Small cuts in the eggs let the sauce soak in, so the eggs taste of curry too.

why.title: A gentle simmer
why.body: Small bubbles cook the sauce without splashing. Big bubbles spatter and burn the bottom.

wrong.fix: They cooked too long or too hot. Add the tomato sauce right away next time.
Stir in a little water, 2 tablespoons at a time.
Serve it with plain yogurt on the side.

quiz.q: How long do the spices cook in the oil?
Why cut slits in the eggs?
What does a gentle simmer look like?

steps.text: Lower the eggs into the saucepan with the slotted spoon. Add cold water to cover them by 1 inch.
steps.tip: Lower them gently so they don't crack.

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil over high heat, with the lid off.
Turn off the burner. Put the lid on and leave the eggs in the hot water.
Move the eggs into a bowl of ice water with the slotted spoon.
Tap and roll each egg, then peel it from the wide end.
steps.look: Smooth white eggs, no bits of shell.

steps.text: Cut one egg in half. The yolk should be firm all the way through.

target.look: Firm yellow yolk, no runny middle

steps.text: Cut 3 small slits down the side of each egg with the butter knife.
steps.tip: Don't cut all the way through.

steps.text: Measure the cumin, turmeric, and paprika into the small bowl.
Heat the oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add the frozen onion and stir now and then.
Stir in the ginger and garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the spices from the small bowl for 30 seconds.
steps.tip: Have the tomato sauce ready to pour.

steps.text: Pour in the tomato sauce, the sauce's water, and the salt. Stir.
steps.tip: It may spit. Pour it in close to the pan.

steps.text: Add the eggs. Turn the heat to low and simmer, spooning sauce over the eggs.
steps.look: Small bubbles, and a thicker sauce.

steps.text: Heat the rice pouches in the microwave as the package says.
steps.tip: Squeeze the pouch first to break up the rice.

steps.text: Turn off the stove. Stir in the garam masala. Scatter the cilantro on top.
steps.look: Eggs coated in a thick red sauce.

steps.text: Serve the eggs and sauce over the rice.
steps.tip: Cut an egg open on your plate to mix it with the sauce.
